subject: Renewal intake: aligning timeline, QBR slotting & capacity uplift options
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@datascout.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal intake: aligning timeline, QBR slotting & capacity uplift options

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Quadra's renewal with Redwood is coming up in late January, and per our playbook I'd like to kick off the coordination so we can lock timelines, surface any capacity needs, and schedule the QBR. High-level asks below: 

- Confirm primary renewal decision-maker and any procurement/legal contacts (I copied Jonas from Renewals).
- Share a preferred QBR week between Jan 18–29 (we'll propose a 60-min slot for exec + ops readout).
- Do you expect a capacity uplift or new dedicated throughput commitments next term? If so, any forecast % uplift and target SLA tier (standard vs. premium)?
- Can you attach the most recent usage report (token/embedding volumes) for Nov–Oct so we can model cost/throughput?

I've attached a draft mutual action checklist and a placeholder MSA so legal has a starting point. If it's helpful we can run a pre-QBR technical deep-dive to validate burst sizing.

Next steps: if I don't hear back by EOD Friday I'll propose two QBR slots and a draft MAP for your review.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Renewal & Expansion
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_msa_draft_v2.pdf (MSA draft, redline-ready)
From: Samir Patel <samir@datascout.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <mgomez@quadra.com>, contracts@quadra.com
Date: 2026-11-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake: aligning timeline, QBR slotting & capacity uplift options

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the heads up. Quick answers inline: 

- Decision-maker: Maria Gomez (cc'd) for commercial; Ben Holloway in procurement (contracts@quadra.com) is on copy.
- QBR window: Jan 18–29 works; prefer Jan 21 or 26 mornings PT.
- Capacity uplift: likely yes — we're forecasting a ~35% increase in embedding volume for H1 next year as we roll out a new search product. We may want a reserved burst pool for predictable latency during peak batch scoring.
- Usage report: attaching the Nov-Oct export now (filename: Quadra_MVP_usage_report.csv).

Also, legal will review the MSA draft and circle back with comments — thanks for providing that. Can you include an estimate of cost delta for the 35% uplift (both best-effort and reserved capacity pricing)? That'll help our finance team.

Samir
Head of ML Platform
DataScout.ai
Attachment: Quadra_MVP_usage_report.csv (usage export, CSV)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@datascout.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake: aligning timeline, QBR slotting & capacity uplift options

Appreciate the quick reply and the usage file — that's perfect. 

Short plan from our side (draft MAP):
1) Week of Nov 29: Redwood will model the cost/throughput impact of +0%, +20%, +35%, +50% embedding growth and share a short readout (cost delta worksheet attached).
2) Week of Dec 6: joint technical sizing session (30–45 min) to validate burst pool sizing and KV cache behavior with your scoring pipelines. Jonas will lead the sizing call.
3) Jan 18–29: Formal QBR + renewal exec decision. Proposed time slots: Jan 21 09:00–10:00 PT or Jan 26 10:00–11:00 PT. Please confirm.
4) Contracting: we'll surface a redline-ready MSA + term amendment by Dec 10 to give legal two weeks for review.

I've attached the initial cost worksheet and our MAP PDF. Ben from Sales Ops is cc'd to help with reserved capacity quotes and billing cadence.

If Maria or procurement have any hard constraints (e.g., PO process, payment terms, required supporting evidence like SOC2), flag them now so we can prep the packet.

Hannah
Attachment: cost_delta_worksheet.xlsx, renewal_map_v1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake: aligning timeline, QBR slotting & capacity uplift options

Looping in executive availability for the QBR and a quick note from a leadership lens — please include a short slide that calls out: current latency SLOs, any incidents in the last 6 months that affected Quadra, and the proposed SLA uplift if they move to reserved capacity. I want the exec session to be focused and data-driven.

Also, Jonas — please make sure the technical sizing session captures KV cache hit-rate assumptions and expected concurrency during peak daily scoring windows. Ben, I'll rely on you to prepare an initial MRR vs committed capacity table so finance can see monthly delta.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Maria Gomez <mgomez@quadra.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@datascout.ai>
Cc: contracts@quadra.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake: aligning timeline, QBR slotting & capacity uplift options

Thanks, Hannah — Jan 21 09:00 PT works for the QBR. We'll plan for a 60-minute exec + ops session.

Action items on our side: 
- Procurement will brief legal and return any MSA redlines by Dec 22 (contracts@quadra.com).
- Samir will lead the internal sizing prep — we'll join the Dec 6 technical sizing session.
- I'll ask finance to review the draft cost worksheet; if the 35% uplift produces a large delta we'll prioritize reserved capacity options.

One additional ask: can Redwood bring a brief appendix that compares our current open-source model variant vs Redwood-verified quantized variants for the embedding pipeline? That would help our infra team decide if quantization can reduce the reserved capacity requirement.

Looking forward to the QBR on Jan 21.

Maria Gomez
VP Product, Quadra Health
